trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Web Walker
entries: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The spider makes two melee attacks: one with its bite and one with its stinger; or the spider can make one attack with its web spinner followed by a melee attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) piercing damage, and the target must make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 27 ({@damage 6d8}) poison damage and is {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute.

action.name: Stinger
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d12 + 3}) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} for 1 minute.

action.name: Web Spinner
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 40 ft., one target. {@h} The target is pulled 40 feet toward the spider and is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}).

reaction.name: Arterial Spray
entries: When the spider takes damage while below half its hit point maximum, it can spray poisonous blood in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 13 ({@damage 3d8}) poison damage and is {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute.

trait.name: Acid Blisters
entries: Whenever the draudnu takes damage, each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage 2d8} acid damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

trait.name: Form of Madness
entries: Any creature other than a fiend that starts its turn within 60 feet of the draudnu must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or be overwhelmed by the belief that something is growing inside it. A creature afflicted in this way is {@condition poisoned}. A Greater Restoration spell or similar magic ends this effect. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the draudnu's Form of Madness for the next 24 hours.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The draudnu has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The draudnu's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Vicious Critical
entries: The draudnu scores a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The draudnu makes three attacks with its Flesh Hooks.

action.name: Flesh Hook
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is {@condition restrained}, as it is pinned down by the draudnu's flesh hook. A creature restrained in this way can use an action to attempt a {@dc 16} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) or Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check, freeing itself on a success, but taking {@damage 1d10} slashing damage. The draudnu has three hooks, each of which can restrain one creature.

trait.name: Form of Madness
entries: Any creature other than a fiend that starts its turn within 60 feet of the ekolid must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or begin to hallucinate that tiny insects are crawling over its hair, clothes, and skin. A creature that is hallucinating in this way suffers disadvantage on all ability checks and on Constitution saving throws made to maintain concentration on a spell. A Lesser Restoration spell or similar magic ends this effect. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the ekolid's Form of Madness for 24 hours.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The ekolid has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Supernatural Quickness
entries: The ekolid can take the Dash action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ekolid makes six attacks with its sting.

action.name: Sting
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or become infested with an ekolid egg. At the start of the target's next turn, the egg hatches and the target takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) piercing damage as the ekolid grub gnaws its way out of the victim. The grub has AC 5, 1 hit point, and no effective attacks, and grows into an adult ekolid after {@dice 1d8} hours.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The golothoma can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Dimensional Reach
entries: The golothoma can reach between dimensions to strike targets with its claws, giving its claw attacks a reach of 60 feet (included in the attack).

trait.name: Form of Madness
entries: Any creature other than a fiend that starts its turn within 60 feet of the golothoma must succeed on a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw or become obsessed with shadows, gaining disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks unless it is in dim light. A Greater Restoration spell or similar magic ends this effect. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the golothoma's Form of Madness for 24 hours.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The golothoma has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The golothoma's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Ravenous Shadow
entries: Whenever a creature ends its turn within 15 feet of the golothoma, it must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution saving throw or gain 1 level of exhaustion. Whenever a creature gains a level of exhaustion in this way, the golothoma recovers 5 hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The golothoma makes three attacks: two with its claws and one with its tail.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 60 ft., one target. {@h}23 ({@damage 3d10 + 7}) slashing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d6 + 7}) bludgeoning damage plus 28 ({@damage 8d6}) acid damage.

trait.name: Form of Madness
entries: Any creature other than a fiend that starts its turn within 60 feet of the uzollru must succeed on a {@dc 19} Charisma saving throw or have its Charisma score reduced to 1 until the start of its next turn. A Greater Restoration spell or similar magic ends this effect. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the uzollru's Form of Madness for 24 hours.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The uzollru has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The uzollru's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The uzollru regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The uzollru uses its Stunning Gaze. Then it makes two attacks with its claws.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 15} to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. {@h}27 ({@damage 4d8 + 9}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 22}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}. The uzollru has two claws, each of which can grapple only one target.

action.name: Feeder Tentacles
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 15} to hit, reach 30 ft., one target {@condition grappled} by the uzollru. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d8 + 9}) piercing damage and the target's Constitution score is reduced by {@dice 2d6}. The target dies if this reduces its Constitution score to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest.

action.name: Stunning Gaze
entries: The uzollru targets one creature it can see within 120 feet of it. That creature must succeed on a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition stunned} for 1 minute. A stunned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

legendary.name: Glide
entries: The uzollru moves up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Implacable
entries: If the uzollru is {@condition grappled} or {@condition restrained}, it ends the condition on itself.

legendary.name: Liquefy (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The uzollru targets one creature it can see within 60 feet of it that is immune to its Form of Madness. The target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} for 1 minute and lose its immunity to the uzollru's Form of Madness.

trait.name: Forest Camouflage
entries: The verakia has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in forested terrain.

trait.name: Form of Madness
entries: Any creature other than a fiend that starts its turn within 60 feet of the verakia must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or be overwhelmed by raw fury, using its action each turn to make a melee attack against a creature other than itself or the verakia. A Greater Restoration spell or similar magic ends this effect. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the verakia's Form of Madness for 24 hours.

trait.name: Freedom of Movement
entries: The verakia ignores difficult terrain, and magical effects can't reduce its speed or cause it to be restrained. It can spend 5 feet of movement to escape from nonmagical restraints or being grappled.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The verakia has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The verakia's weapon attacks are magical.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The verakia makes four attacks: two with its talons and one each with its bite and tail. If the verakia hits the same target with three or more of these attacks, the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}26 ({@damage 4d8 + 8}) piercing damage.

action.name: Talon
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d8 + 8}) slashing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 25 ft., one target. {@h}30 ({@damage 4d10 + 8}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 21} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Breath Weapon (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The verakia exhales unholy fire in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 45 ({@damage 10d8}) fire damage and its Charisma score is reduced by {@dice 1d6}. The reduction lasts until the creature finishes a long rest. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and its Charisma score isn't reduced.

monster.name: Eyesore
languages: understands Deep Speech and Undercommon but can't speak

action.name: Eye Powers
entries: The eyesore uses two of the following magical eye powers:

items: {@b Charm Aura.} All creatures within 30 feet of the eyesore must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by the eyesore for 1 hour, or until the eyesore harms the creature.

{@b Paralyzing Aura.} All creatures within 30 feet of the eyesore must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

{@b Sickening Aura.} All creatures within 30 feet of the eyesore must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or take 18 ({@damage 4d8}) poison damage and be {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute, or half as much damage and not be poisoned on a successful one.

{@b Fear Aura.} All creatures within 30 feet of the eyesore must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

{@b Slowing Aura.} All creatures within 30 feet of the eyesore must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target's speed is halved for 1 minute. In addition, the creature can't take reactions, and it can take either an action or a bonus action on its turn, not both.

{@b Psychic Wave.} All creatures within 30 feet of the eyesore must make a {@dc 17} Intelligence saving throw, taking 36 ({@damage 8d8}) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful save.

{@b Telekinetic Field.} The eyesore can target a single object or creature within 30 feet of it. Any creature targeted must make a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or the eyesore moves it up to 30 feet in any direction. It is {@condition restrained} by the aura's crushing force until the start of the eyesore's next turn.

{@b Healing Aura.} All creatures within 30 feet of the eyesore (including the eyesore) magically regain 36 ({@damage 8d8}) hit points and are freed from any curse, disease, poison, blindness, or deafness.

{@b Invulnerability Aura.} A 15-foot radius globe surrounds the eyesore until the start of the eyesore's next turn. Any spell of 5th level or higher cast from outside the barrier can't affect creatures or objects within it.

{@b Flame Aura.} All creatures within 30 feet of the eyesore must make a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw, taking 36 ({@damage 8d8}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

monster.name: Gate Golem

immune.note: from nonmagical weapons that aren't adamantine

languages: understands the languages of its creator but cannot speak

trait.name: Gate Form
entries: The golem can occupy a 15 feet square area and act as a vault gate. When acting in this manner, a creature must succeed on a {@dc 18} Intelligence (Investigation) or a {@dc 22} Wisdom (Perception) check to discern the true nature of the golem. When the golem extends its legs, it can create enough space for a Medium creature to pass without any hindrance, or a Large creature while crouching. Any attempt to tamper with the gate such as using Thieves' Tools automatically turns the golem hostile.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Shielded Build
entries: The golem has a gate on its back that acts as a shield. When the golem is targeted from behind, its AC is increased to 22.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The golem makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d10 + 6}) bludgeoning damage.

monster.name: Golden Hound

resist.note: from nonmagical weapons that aren't adamantine

languages: understands the languages of its creator but cannot speak

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: The golem has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The golem has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the golem's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The golem makes two bite attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

monster.name: Golden Angel

immune.note: from nonmagical weapons that aren't adamantine

languages: understands the languages of its creator but cannot speak

trait.name: Golden Body
entries: The golem is made of gold and other metals. It has resistance against spells that deal damage against objects and constructs. Furthermore, if the golem is slain, it can be salvaged for golden plates worth around 2,000 gp. It can only be salvaged with tools made of adamantine or with magic such as a hand torch.

trait.name: Golden Sentinel
entries: When the golem is deactivated it appears to be a statue. A creature must succeed on a {@dc 19} Wisdom (Perception) or {@dc 17} Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern the true nature of the golem.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The golem makes three melee attacks: two with its sword and one with its wings.

action.name: Golden Sword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d8 + 7}) slashing damage.

action.name: Wing Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) slashing damage.

reaction.name: Wing Parry
entries: The golem uses its wings to raise its AC by 2 against a single attack.

monster.name: Porcelain Arcanoroid

immune.note: from nonmagical weapons that aren't adamantine

languages: can understand and speak all languages

trait.name: Aberrant Movement
entries: Whenever the Arcanoroid moves more than 10 feet in a single turn, its AC increases by 2.

trait.name: Agile Frame
entries: The Arcanoroid compensates its fragility with quick movements. Whenever the Arcanoroid takes damage, it can immediately choose to move 5 feet in the opposite direction.

trait.name: Arcanoroid
entries: The Arcanoroid has advantage on all Charisma (Deception) checks to masquerade as a living being. When wearing heavy clothing, the Arcanoroid is indistinguishable from a living being, unless it is examined from within 5 feet.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The Arcanoroid is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Porcelain Body
entries: The Arcanoroid is made of porcelain and organic materials. It has immunity against spells that deal damage against objects and constructs.

trait.name: Tongue of Ancients
entries: The Arcanoroid can understand and speak all languages, as if it was constantly under the tongues spell.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Arcanoroid makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Retractable Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) slashing damage.

reaction.name: Abrupt Dodge
entries: The Arcanoroid can use its reaction to increase its AC by 5 against a single attack.

immune.note: from nonmagical weapons that aren't adamantine

trait.name: Greedy Weapons
entries: Maragoon's weapon attacks are magical and deal an additional 14 ({@damage 4d6}) psychic damage.

trait.name: Innate Spellcasting
entries: Maragoon's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 24}, {@hit 16} to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:
At will: detect magic, detect thoughts, disguise self, fireball, prestidigitation
3/day each: charlatan's escape, deceiver's mask, dimensional swap, diminish wealth, plane shift, sanctify deal, scholar's riposte, teleport
1/day each: destroy wealth, escape the mind's eye, mind lock, suffocate, weight of riches

trait.name: Know Wealth
entries: Maragoon knows the approximate value of all possessions of creatures it can see, including gold, magic items, or properties, even if they are not carried by the creature.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Maragoon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Maragoon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Special Equipment
entries: Maragoon wields the Golden Rapier.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Maragoon makes three attacks: two with its weapon, one with its tail.

action.name: Golden Rapier
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 16} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 1d8 + 9}) piercing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) psychic damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 1d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) psychic damage.

action.name: Summon Wealth (Recharge 5-6)
entries: Maragoon summons a pile of illusory coins in a point within 120 feet that it can see. Any creature within 30 feet of the coin pile must succeed on a {@dc 24} Wisdom saving throw, or they are {@condition charmed} by the coin pile for 1 minute. Charmed creatures rush towards it and jump inside, filling their pockets. A charmed creature can make a new save at the end of its turn. Taking any damage allows the creature to break free from this effect.

action.name: Visions of Greed (Recharge 6)
entries: Maragoon sends out a psychic blast in a 30-foot radius. All creatures within the area must succeed on a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw, or they are plagued with visions of their belongings and their imminent fall to poverty. Creatures that fail are {@condition stunned} and take {@damage 2d6} psychic damage. If a creature has extraordinary wealth, the DC increases by 5 for each 50,000 gp worth of items the creature has.

reaction.name: Collect Souls
entries: When a creature is slain within 300 feet of Maragoon, it may use its reaction to collect the soul and transform it into a soul gem. A creature cannot be resurrected while its soul is captured. The soul must be collected in the same turn the creature is slain.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: Maragoon makes one attack.

legendary.name: Teleport
entries: Maragoon magically teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

legendary.name: Consume Souls (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Maragoon consumes a harvested soul and regains 42 ({@damage 12d6}) hit points.

monster.name: Hargarin Golem
languages: understands the languages of its creator but cannot speak

trait.name: Arcane Nullification Field
entries: Any spells of 6th level or below are automatically suppressed while within 60 feet of the golem.

trait.name: Arcane Valediction
entries: When the golem reaches 0 hit points, it explodes with magical energy in a 30-foot radius. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw, taking 45 ({@damage 10d6 + 10}) force damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. If a spellcaster takes damage from this attack, it rolls three d6 dice, regaining a spell slot for the rolled spell level for each die.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Absorption
entries: Whenever the golem is subjected to damage by a spell or magical effect, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the damage dealt. Furthermore, whenever the golem successfully makes a melee attack against a creature with spell slots, roll a {@dice 1d6}. The target loses a spell level equal to the dice result.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The golem makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Crystal Spear
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 15} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d8 + 9}) piercing damage.

legendary.name: Attack
entries: The golem makes one melee attack.

legendary.name: Conjure Spear
entries: The golem conjures a Crystal Spear.

legendary.name: Teleport (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The golem magically teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can perceive.

immune.note: from nonmagical weapons that aren't adamantine

trait.name: Blinding Greed
entries: Large or smaller creatures that occupy the same space as the coinmass are {@condition blinded}.

trait.name: Coin Form
entries: The coinmass can occupy the same space as any other creature.

trait.name: Coin Movement
entries: The ooze can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. When the ooze moves into the same square as other creatures, they take 5 ({@damage 1d10}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Formless
entries: The coinmass can move through a space as narrow as 1 foot wide without squeezing.

trait.name: Hoard's Lure
entries: While masquerading as a hoard or treasure, the coinmass can communicate telepathically with creatures and attempt to lure them closer. A creature must succeed on a {@dc 21} Wisdom saving throw to resist these commands. If a creature succeeds, they are immune to this calling for 24 hours.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The hoard's attacks are magical.

trait.name: Meld into Hoard
entries: While standing idle, the coinmass is indistinguishable from a hoard of treasure.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ooze can make three slam attacks, each of which it can replace with Spit Coins or Torrent of Coins.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d8 + 9}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Spit Coins (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The coinmass spits coins in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 22} Dexterity saving throw, taking 72 ({@damage 16d8}) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

action.name: Torrent of Coins (Recharge 5-6)
entries: The coinmass violently oscillates, hurling thousands of sharp coins in the space it occupies. Each creature that occupies the same space must succeed on a {@dc 23} Dexterity saving throw, taking 54 ({@damage 12d8}) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Prone creatures take double damage.

monster.name: Chain Horror

immune.note: from nonmagical weapons that aren't adamantine

languages: understands the languages of its creator but cannot speak

trait.name: Encased Movement
entries: The golem can move while grappling other creatures. When it moves, encased creatures can use their reactions to attempt an escape or prevent the golem from moving with a successful {@dc 18} Strength saving throw.

trait.name: Free Chains
entries: The golem is always under the freedom of movement spell.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Shifting Chains
entries: The golem can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the golem can move through any opening large enough for a Small creature.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The golem makes two chain whip attacks. The number of attacks is decreased for each target it uses Encase on.

action.name: Chain Whip
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 4d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Encase
entries: Whenever the golem makes a Chain Whip attack on a creature that it occupies the same space with, the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}). Until the grapple ends the target is {@condition restrained}. The golem can release restrained targets at will. Encase can only be used on Large or smaller creatures.

action.name: Torrent of Chains
entries: Whenever a creature starts their turn in a square that the golem occupies, it takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) slashing damage. Grappled targets take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) piercing damage instead.

trait.name: Innate Spellcasting
entries: The Watcher's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 18}, {@hit 10} to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:
At will: detect magic, detect thoughts, gaseous form, zone of truth
3/day each: fireball, locate creature, sending
1/day each: harm, hold monster, teleport

trait.name: Flame of Binding
entries: The watcher is bound to a place it has to protect. Unless the flame is put out, the Watcher cannot die. If slain, its corpse and equipment are disintegrated, and it appears in an empty square within 30 feet of the flame on its next turn. A watcher bound to a place knows the location of all creatures within 300 feet, and can raise or lower alarms connected to the place at will.

trait.name: Watcher's Resistance
entries: The watcher has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead as long as it remains within 300 feet of the fire it is bound to.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The watcher makes two Black Bolt attacks or two Fiery Touch attacks.

action.name: Black Bolt
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 10} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) necrotic damage plus 13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) fire damage.

action.name: Fiery Touch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage plus 6 ({@damage 2d6}) fire damage.
